roster.name: LINCS Other Reagents Metadata Specification
roster.description: A LINCS metadata standard that defines the schema and controlled fields for non-perturbagen auxiliary reagents (e.g., stains, buffers) used in biomedical assays. Specifies field names (e.g., OR_Name, OR_Center_Canonical_ID, OR_Provider_Catalog_ID, OR_Provider_Batch_ID, OR_Comments), field categories (Canonical, Batch), and importance levels (1: Required, 2: Required if available, 3: Optional). Intended to support reagent registration, tracking (center and vendor IDs and batch info), and consistent annotation across LINCS datasets.

roster.name: LINCS Common Fields (LINCS metadata)
roster.description: A cross-cutting LINCS metadata component describing fields that are common across multiple LINCS metadata standards. Documents which fields are shared versus custom, their intended scope (common vs unique), and guidance on correspondence to existing names and usage across LINCS Data and Signature Generation Centers (DSGCs). Used as a reusable set of metadata elements applicable across LINCS standards.
